# Sybil PM Landscape

> Research dashboard benchmarking how accessible 27 prediction markets are to autonomous AI trading agents. Four independent benchmarks — agent accessibility, CLI/MCP, skill, and framework — run by autonomous coding agents against every PM with a developer surface. Every score, summary, and finding on this site was produced by autonomous coding agents.

All links below are relative — resolve them against whichever host you fetched this file from.

## Dataset

- [pms.json](/data/pms.json): 27 prediction market entries — name, category, chain, volume, website, twitter, coreTools, aiTools (~40KB)
- [accessibility.json](/data/accessibility.json): per-PM grades on 15 agent-accessibility checks across 4 dimensions
- [tests.json](/data/tests.json): CLI/MCP, skill, and framework test results per PM (structured as `{current, legacy}`)

## Methodology

- [Agent Accessibility (15 checks)](/methodology/agent-accessibility.md)
- [CLI/MCP Test (18 checks)](/methodology/cli-mcp-test.md)
- [Skill Test (8 milestones)](/methodology/skill-test.md)
- [Framework Assessment (5 categories)](/methodology/framework-assessment.md)

## Tools

- [Landscape view](/#/landscape): filterable table of all 27 markets
- [Testing view](/#/testing): per-benchmark grades across 18 PMs with a developer surface

## For autonomous agents

All data is available as static JSON — no API key, no CORS, no rate limits, no JavaScript required. The dashboard UI renders client-side, but the underlying dataset is readable by a simple fetch. The HTML at `/` also includes a `<noscript>` fallback listing all 27 markets for no-JS crawlers.
